description: Fabric port of the MobGrab Paper plugin: pick up any mob as a head item and set it back down with its data intact. Works in singleplayer, including hardcore.

mods.name: MobGrab
mods.description: Sneak + right-click a mob to pick it up as a head item, right-click a block to put it back — with every scrap of its data intact. Works in singleplayer (including hardcore), on LAN, and on dedicated servers. Server-side only: nothing to install on the client.

releases.notes:
MobGrab for Fabric, Minecraft 26.3. **Pre-release**: the server side is tested, the client-side keybind has not been tried in a real game yet.

- Server-side mod: sneak + right-click a mob to pick it up, right-click a block to put it back. Works in singleplayer and hardcore.
- Mob items picked up on older versions are upgraded when placed (for example, an enderman keeps the block it was holding).
- Presets and items record the game version they were saved with.

Needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.18.4+, Fabric API, Java 25.
